item.title: OWNE AI Trust Platform
item.description:
AI-powered authentication and digital provenance

At OWNE, I lead the technology transformation strategy behind an AI-powered trust platform for the luxury industry.

Technical focus

  • Computer-vision authentication workflows
  • Precision-weighted scoring and confidence thresholds
  • Human review paths for undetermined cases
  • Responsible AI and model-governance controls
  • Identity, security, data governance, and cloud foundations
  • Digital Product Passports and trusted data exchange
  • Future interoperability across brands, marketplaces, insurers, and financial institutions

Professional relevance

This work brings together applied machine learning, computer vision, product architecture, digital identity, fraud prevention, and enterprise security.

item.title: Responsible AI and Secure MLOps
item.description:
Governing AI from experimentation to production

I advise organizations on the controls required to operate predictive, generative, and agentic AI systems responsibly.

Core practices

  • AI use-case risk assessment and prioritization
  • Data governance and model-governance frameworks
  • Model evaluation, monitoring, and performance thresholds
  • Secure MLOps and LLMOps operating practices
  • Human-in-the-loop escalation and review
  • AI security architecture, identity, access, and auditability
  • Executive KPIs for value, risk, adoption, and resilience

Outcome

The goal is not simply to deploy models. It is to create secure, measurable, accountable systems that can be trusted at enterprise scale.
